nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Use one explore sub-agent for the complete WooCommerce product extraction only. Call the product-list operation with perPage=100 and increasing page numbers until the terminal short or empty page; omit status and category filters so every observed product is covered. Project each product to exact ID, full name, SKU, stock quantity, regular price, and the ordered category-name list, reject duplicate IDs, and persist the complete projection once to a runtime-unique products_raw.json. Return only {path, digest, pages, returned_product_count, unique_product_count, null_field_counts, terminal_page_count}; do not return all product rows in prose and do not create either spreadsheet or email.

explore 1 (financial-market-analyst 0): Use one explore sub-agent to retrieve historical daily prices for gold futures symbol GC=F (interval 1d), select the five most recent distinct trading dates, and return exactly five {date, close} rows sorted newest first plus symbol/date/count controls. Do not write files or create external state.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): One coder sub-agent is a pure computation owner. It reads only `products_raw.json` and the persisted gold rows, and in one script execution writes one JSON payload containing: the Category Inventory table (8 rows — `Product_Count`, `Total_Stock`, `Avg_Price` per category, first listed category for products with multiple categories, raw averages preserved until final two-decimal rounding); the Restock Alerts table (every product with stock strictly below 10); and the Gold Trend table (the five `{date, close}` rows). The payload script itself prints the table controls (8 category rows, low-stock count, 5 gold rows) as its only verification. Return only the payload path and those printed controls. Do not create Excel files, spreadsheets, or emails; do not run a separate validation script; do not re-run.
